messages:
Ravi (Product): Heads-up: were GA-ing Hosted API Tool-Calling + Streaming v1 today at 15:00 PT. This release formalizes tool schemas, improves streaming chunk reliability, and adds structured validation. Docs & migration guide: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/toolcall-streaming-v1 :tada:

Nina (DevEx): Nice. Will SDKs ship at the same time? Need examples for common patterns (sync tool call, async streaming).

Ravi (Product): Yes - DevEx will publish SDK v1.2.0 at release time with helpers ToolCallV1 and stream parsers. Theres also a small compatibility shim for most v0 usages but its not feature complete.

Dana (Eng): Rollout plan: Gradual canary: 10% for 30m, 50% for 1h, then 100% if OK. No forced migration; we start a 60-day deprecation countdown for tool_call_v0 at GA.

Theo (SRE): Adding route-level dashboards for streaming tail latency and schema-validation error rates. PagerDuty trigger if validation errors exceed 3% for 10m.

Priya (Legal): Note on data handling: if tool schemas include PII keys, enable audit-logging for Dedicated/Private by default and flag Hosted usage for review. Will update the compliance playbook.

Ravi (Product): Agreed. Default audit flag: on for Private/Dedicated, opt-in for Hosted. Migration checklist will call this out.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: hosted-toolcall-streaming-v1 canary@10% (deploy_id: dpl_2026_06_07_1876543210)

Nina (DevEx): Ill add quickstart snippets to the public docs and prepare a short migration snippet for the release notes channel.

Dana (Eng): If any validator regressions show up, ping me. Ive got a hotfix branch ready to cut and a rollback playbook.

Ravi (Product): Customer-facing blurb (for release notes): "Hosted API: Tool-Calling + Streaming v1 GA. Stable schemas, better streaming reliability, and a 60-day deprecation for tool_call_v0. SDK updates and migration guides available." I'll post that after we confirm canary health.

Theo (SRE): Canary health: all instances healthy after 10 minutes. 0 schema errors in first 15m. Monitoring hooks live.

Ravi (Product): Thanks everyone. Ill pin the migration checklist here and schedule reminders at 30d and 7d before the v0 shutdown.
